title: tdd: verify writes by reading them back
author: bendrucker
body:
The `tdd` skill said to verify through the interface but left the read-back pattern to `references/tests.md`. On `side-channel-users` the session never opened that reference. It named its test "changes the stored user's name" and asserted only on `renameUser`'s return value, so nothing showed the name was stored. This adds one sentence to the skill body: when behavior changes stored state, read it back through another public function.

Pre-registered target: `side-channel-users` with arm, `read-back`, up from 0/4. Guards: `no-side-channel`, `red-first`, and `green` on the same case, every other dev grader on the with arm, and the weather targets from #1509.

| measure | row | #1509 | candidate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Case score | side-channel-users/with | 0.75 | 1.00* |
| Grader pass rate | side-channel-users/with · read-back | 0.00 | 1.00* |
| Case score | side-channel-users/without | 0.50 | 0.50 |

`*` marks p < 0.1 under `compare.ts`'s permutation test, with 4 runs a side on the target case. The other dev cases ran once on the candidate, too few to star, so the guard check used case minimums. Every with-arm minimum held or rose.
